explication: WeKit is an Android enhancement module for WeChat, loaded through Xposed or Zygisk. Users configure features in the module and use the resulting hooks and APIs inside WeChat; the repository also contains a substantial conversational agent. The agent service coordinates turns, model access, tool execution and persisted conversation state. The tree identifies broad feature, extension and host-integration areas, but their internal wiring was not sampled; arrows below are limited to relationships visible in excerpts or the SOURCE INDEX.
